screening.reviewer: agent metadata review; no independent expert or full-text adjudication
screening.armMasking: screening pack omits arm membership; not a double-blind trial
screening.population: University/college/tertiary students must be described in participant/title/education-level metadata, not inferred from author institution alone. Unknown stays unknown.
screening.intervention: For ai_feedback_writing, AI provides feedback on student writing; AI drafting alone is insufficient. For peer_feedback_writing, students provide feedback/editing on each others writing; generic peer review/publication or AI-only feedback is insufficient. Mixed interventions are kept uncertain unless the relevant component is explicit.
screening.outcomes: writing_performance, feedback_process, self_efficacy_perception, secondary_review, none, unclear. These describe evidence type, never scientific quality or an approved effect.
screening.unknownPolicy: No abstract/participant/intervention clarity is not evidence of exclusion; title can support explicit scope, but missing details remain unknown.
screening.qualityMetrics: Per-source first-page metadata-label counts and lower/upper descriptive relevance fractions; never recall. Failed/unvisited slots are not empty results. Compare added/lost exact source-record IDs; metadata versions remain distinct.
screening.anchors: Predeclared known records, not a complete gold universe. Absence from first pages is a probe miss, not proof of database absence.
